name: Geogames
storyline:
GeoGames turns the real world into a multiplayer playground. Using Google Street View, players explore cities, search for landmarks, follow clues, hide from rivals, chase opponents, and compete across real-world streets.

In City Meet-up, lost players must communicate to find each other. In GeoBingo, they complete a bingo card by spotting real-world objects and places. In Hide & Seek, one player hides somewhere in Street View while the others try to discover the location. Rally challenges players to reach checkpoints, while Scotland Yard turns the city into a pursuit between police and thieves.

Every match is different because the world itself is the game board.
summary:
GeoGames is a browser-based geography game platform built around Google Street View. Players explore real-world locations, navigate streets, and compete or cooperate through several game modes.

The main mode, City Meet-up, challenges players or teams who start lost in the same city to find each other using only communication and orientation skills. Other modes include GeoBingo, where players complete a bingo card by finding real-world objects and landmarks; Hide & Seek, where one player hides and others try to discover the location; Rally, focused on reaching checkpoints; and Scotland Yard, a pursuit mode between police and thieves.

GeoGames is an multiplayer project designed for quick online sessions, geography fans, streamers, and players who enjoy exploration, deduction, and real-world navigation.
